name: Send a daily Reddit and TikTok brand mention digest with trend alerts to Slack using Juicer and OpenAI

parameters.content:
## Daily social digest with trend alerts
For marketers and founders who want a two-minute morning read on what people say about their brand plus a warning when the conversation suddenly grows or turns negative.

### How it works
1. Every morning the Juicer node searches Reddit and TikTok for your keyword in one call.
2. A Code step keeps posts from the last 2 days that really mention it.
3. An OpenAI model writes the digest (themes, mood, 3 posts worth reading) and estimates the share of negative posts.
4. The workflow compares volume and negative share with the previous run and adds a heads-up line when either jumps.
5. The digest is posted to Slack.

### Setup
About 10 minutes.

1. Add your Juicer API key (Developer page in Juicer) to **Search Reddit and TikTok**.
2. Set your keyword, Slack channel and alert thresholds in **Your settings**.
3. Connect OpenAI and Slack.
4. Activate the workflow. The comparison is remembered between scheduled runs, not manual test runs.

Each run spends Juicer API credits per platform (Reddit 1, TikTok 3).

### Requirements
- A Juicer account with an API key
- OpenAI and Slack accounts

### Customization tips
- Add X, Instagram, YouTube or LinkedIn. For those, use a #hashtag with Term Type Hashtag.
- Change the hour in **Every morning**.

This template uses the verified Juicer community node (n8n-nodes-juicer). On self-hosted n8n, install it first under Settings > Community nodes.

## 1. Find posts
Set your keyword, search the networks and keep fresh posts that mention it.

## 2. Summarize and compare
The AI writes the digest; the workflow compares it with the last run.

## 3. Share it
Post the digest to Slack.

attributes.name: digest
attributes.description: A short Slack digest: 3 to 5 themes people talk about, the overall mood and the 3 posts most worth reading with their links. Use Slack formatting: *bold* with single asterisks, plain lists, no headings and no tables.

attributes.name: negative_share
attributes.description: Percent of the posts (0 to 100) that are negative about the topic.
